event.name: FOOTYUP x GOINGFORGOAT College Combine
event.infoText:
Players will participate in an elite three-day college soccer combine designed to provide exposure to college coaches, professional athletic performance testing, and high-level competition.

The combine will feature approximately 20–30 college programs attending each of the boys' and girls' events, giving athletes the opportunity to showcase their abilities in front of college coaches.

Every registered player will receive an exclusive GOINGFORGOAT x FOOTYUP package, shipped directly to their home before the combine. The package will include exclusive combine apparel, including kits for the combine, and additional player gear.

Throughout the event, athletes will participate in competitive training sessions, small-sided games, full-field matches, and advanced athletic performance testing using VALD technology. Players will have the opportunity to demonstrate their technical ability, athleticism, tactical awareness, and overall potential at the collegiate level.

Please ensure all registration information, apparel sizing, and shipping details are accurate before submitting.
